title: The remote head was parsed from scrubbed output, so a short secret matching part of the ref or object name corrupted the result
resolution: GitRunner.runParsed parses the raw ls-remote output inside the runner and scrubs only failure messages; tests with a short secret matching the task branch ref and an object name.

title: A time limit above the setTimeout maximum passed validation and fired after 1 ms
resolution: Time limits above MAX_GIT_TIME_LIMIT_MS (2147483647 ms) are a RangeError; the boundary test accepts the maximum and refuses one more.

title: The time limit failure message was not scrubbed, so a credential form in the client path could leak
resolution: The runner scrubs each whole composed message, the time limit and the start failure, path included; tests with a secret inside the client path.

title: The runner time limit test raced a real timer against the shell recording its pids and had no upper bound
resolution: An injected ManualGitTimer fires after the client recorded its pids atomically; a watchdog bounds termination at 30 s and cleanup kills leftovers.

title: The stalled remote tests relied on the request reaching the server before a real 1500 ms timer
resolution: The server's beforeAnswer hook signals the received request, then the test fires the injected timer; a watchdog bounds completion and cleanup expires the timer.

title: The pass 1 fix let the parser read raw output, but the living requirement Scrubbed Git output still demanded scrubbing every process's standard output and the delta did not modify it
resolution: The delta modifies Scrubbed Git output: a parser in the runner reads the raw output and only its value leaves unscrubbed; scenarios for a short secret in the task branch ref and in a failure message; archive dry run passes.

title: succeeded() composed the failure message outside the runner, so its fixed text and exit code were not scrubbed of a short credential form
resolution: runChecked and runParsed compose the message from the raw standard error and scrub it whole once; push and clone use runChecked; test with secret 128 as the exit code.

title: runParsed scrubbed a parser's failure message but passed its details through unchanged
resolution: A parser failure's detail values are scrubbed too; the runner test now asserts a detail holding the output is redacted.

title: The echo-authorization fixture answered only git-upload-pack, so the push case failed in its ls-remote and git push never met a remote that repeats the header
resolution: The echo can target one service; the push case echoes from git-receive-pack and asserts the message comes from the push itself, redacted with no form.

title: A push the remote applied but whose answer was lost returned remote-moved, and a push killed at its time limit waited a second full limit on the re-read
resolution: A re-read equal to the pushed head returns the head; a time-limit failure skips the re-read; tests with a lost receive-pack answer and a stalled git-receive-pack.

title: The fail-before record reported 30 failures but named 29 and said all 126 passing tests were those of 16b
resolution: The record names the redirected prepare advertisement test as the 30th failure and the new test and assertion among the 126 passing.
